title: An optimized filling method for capillary DLS
author: Ruseva, Jankevics, et al.

steps.title: Prepare square capillary
steps.instruction: Obtain a square glass capillary with an internal cross‑section of 1.00 mm × 1.00 mm and a length of 50 mm; handle it carefully to avoid breakage.

steps.title: Load sample by dipping
steps.instruction: Dip the capillary bore into the sample solution so that the liquid fills the channel, then seal the open end with a clay plug to prevent evaporation.

substeps.instruction: Dip capillary into sample solution until the bore fills
Seal the open end with a clay plug

steps.title: Load sample by micro‑pipetting
steps.instruction: Using a long‑reach pipette tip, micro‑pipette a tiny volume of the sample directly into the capillary bore, taking care to avoid air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Attach a long‑reach tip to the pipette
Dispense the sample into the capillary bore
